title: IVB: India on Vande Bharat
description:
A planner for journeys and circuits across India on Vande Bharat trains alone, with an open dataset of the network: 415 stations, 83 routes and 168 trains with their halts, times, days of running and track lines, also published as a GTFS feed.

Website: https://syaamantakdas.github.io/IVB/
notes: The code is under the MIT licence. The data in the data/ folder is under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 (see data/LICENSE); its track lines and distances derive from OpenStreetMap, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. The GTFS feed built from the data is published at https://syaamantakdas.github.io/IVB/gtfs/ivb-gtfs.zip. The names IVB and India on Vande Bharat and the logo are not licensed. IVB is unofficial and not connected with Indian Railways or IRCTC.
